entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on May 11, 2026
entry.content:
🌍 In your language

  • 🇩🇪 Home Assistant DE - German-language Telegram group for discussions, tips, and help.

📦 Third Party Apps

  • C-Gate Web Bridge (⭐4) - Bridge Clipsal C-Bus lighting and automation systems to Home Assistant via MQTT with auto-discovery (4★).

✍️ Blogs / English

  • HomeTechHacker - DIY smart-home guides, reviews, and advice.
  • Intermittent Technology - Quindor's personal blog covering smart home, networking, and adjacent tech.
  • KPeyanski - Tutorials and walkthroughs covering automations, AI integrations, and energy management by Kiril Peyanski.
  • fixtse - Hardware reviews and DIY guides for presence detection, voice assistants, and local AI by Sergio Romero.
  • Michael Leen - Practical setup advice and gear reviews aimed at people building their first smart home.
  • Phil Hawthorne - Field notes on integrations, presence detection, and household automations from a long-time podcaster.
  • Frenck - Behind-the-scenes posts on open source, project leadership, and personal automation experiments by Franck Nijhof.

✍️ Blogs / 🌍 In other languages

  • 🇸🇦 Smart Tech Arabic - Tutorials in Arabic by Shady Nafie (97.8K subs).
  • 🇧🇷 Descomplicando Tech - Smart-home guides by Fabricio Goncalves (15.8K subs).

entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on May 09, 2026
entry.content:
🌡️ Climate

  • Smart Autotune Thermostat (SAT) (⭐243) - Self-tuning thermostat that talks to OpenTherm, ESPHome, or MQTT gateways and adapts the heating curve to your home over time (243★).
  • Dual Smart Thermostat (⭐224) - Enhanced version of the built-in generic thermostat, with separate heating and cooling, floor temperature limits, and humidity controls (224★).

⚡ Energy & solar

  • Solcast PV Forecast (⭐399) - Pulls Solcast solar production forecasts so you can see expected generation for the day, with up-to-the-hour confidence bands (399★).
  • EPEX Spot (⭐302) - Brings hourly EPEX spot electricity prices into your dashboard so you can shift loads to the cheapest slots (302★).
  • ENTSO-e Day-Ahead Prices (⭐264) - Fetches day-ahead electricity prices from the ENTSO-e Transparency Platform across most European countries (264★).
  • SolarEdge Modbus Multi (⭐293) - Reads SolarEdge inverters, meters, and batteries locally over Modbus/TCP, with multi-inverter and three-phase support (292★).
  • FoxESS Modbus (⭐290) - Connects directly to FoxESS solar inverters over Modbus, no cloud round-trips, for real-time status and control (289★).
  • Victron GX (⭐315) - Reads data from a Victron GX device over Modbus/TCP, exposing inverters, batteries, solar chargers, and AC inputs (315★).
  • Solis Sensor (⭐315) - Talks to the SolisCloud PV monitoring portal so you can pull Solis inverter generation, battery, and grid data into the energy dashboard (315★).
  • GoodWe Inverter (⭐209) - Pulls live data from GoodWe solar inverters over the local network for use in the energy dashboard (208★).
  • Solar Optimizer (⭐222) - Starts and stops your appliances based on solar surplus production so you self-consume rather than export (222★).
  • Dynamic Energy Cost (⭐187) - Tracks real-time and cumulative energy cost against a dynamic price feed like Nord Pool or EPEX (186★).
  • Energi Data Service (⭐269) - Fetches Danish electricity spot prices from the Energi Data Service API for use in price-aware automations (269★).

🚨 Security & alarm

  • Keymaster (⭐329) - Manages user codes on Z-Wave smart locks, including per-user schedules, one-time codes, and notifications (329★).

🔊 Voice & media playback

  • View Assist Companion (⭐348) - Companion Android app and integration that turns a tablet into a hands-free voice and dashboard satellite (348★).

🚗 Cars & EV charging

  • Audi Connect (⭐328) - Tracks Audi cars over the Audi Connect API, including charging state, range, lock, and climate preconditioning (328★).
  • Polestar (⭐241) - Reads Polestar EVs through the Polestar app API, with range, charging, and location data (241★).
  • Stellantis Vehicles (⭐223) - Adds Stellantis cars (Peugeot, Citroen, Fiat, Opel, Vauxhall, DS) over the manufacturer API for range, lock, and climate (223★).
  • evcc (⭐387) - Connects to an evcc instance to surface charge sessions, solar matching, and per-loadpoint state (387★).
  • Easee EV Charger (⭐272) - Adds Easee EV chargers with live charge state, dynamic load balancing, and per-session metering (272★).
  • EV Smart Charging (⭐290) - Plans an electric vehicle charging schedule across the cheapest hours of a dynamic tariff, working with most chargers and price sensors (290★).

📍 Presence & location

  • Places (⭐182) - Reverse-geocodes a device tracker location through OpenStreetMap so automations can react to "at the supermarket" rather than raw coordinates (181★).

🔵 Bluetooth & BLE

  • BLE Battery Management Systems (⭐316) - Reads Bluetooth Low Energy battery management systems (BMS) from many vendors, exposing per-cell voltages, balancing, and SOC (316★).
  • EcoFlow BLE (⭐277) - Pulls EcoFlow power stations and accessories over Bluetooth Low Energy, no cloud account required (277★).

🏷️ Vendor & brand

  • Meross LAN (⭐701) - Local control of Meross plugs, switches, lights, and garage door openers, falling back to cloud only when needed (701★).
  • LocalTuya (⭐3.8k) - Local control of Tuya devices over the LAN, no cloud round-trips, supporting plugs, lights, climate, and covers (3,821★).
  • SamsungTV Smart (⭐642) - Improved Samsung TV integration with SmartThings support, source switching, app launching, and per-app icons (642★).
  • Dyson (⭐413) - Wi-Fi connected Dyson fans, purifiers, and humidifiers, with full per-mode control over the local network (411★).
  • PetKit (⭐335) - Adds PetKit feeders, fountains, and litter boxes over the manufacturer cloud, with full state and feeding controls (335★).
  • Miele (⭐268) - Pairs Miele washing machines, dryers, dishwashers, ovens, and coffee machines, with detailed program state (269★).
  • Home Connect Local (⭐364) - Talks to Bosch, Siemens, NEFF, and Gaggenau appliances directly over the local network, no cloud detour (364★).
  • hOn (⭐246) - Pulls Haier, Candy, and Hoover appliances from the official hOn cloud, exposing every state and parameter the app shows (246★).
  • PETLIBRO (⭐305) - Adds PETLIBRO smart pet feeders and fountains, with feeding schedules, dispense events, and battery levels (305★).

🛠️ Automation tooling

  • Retry Service (⭐162) - Wraps any service call so transient failures retry automatically with exponential backoff (162★).

🏘️ Civic & household

  • Smart Irrigation (⭐494) - Calculates how long to run each irrigation zone based on evapotranspiration, recent rainfall, and weather forecasts (494★).
  • UK Bin Collection (⭐320) - Council bin collection schedules across UK local authorities, exposed as next-pickup sensors per waste stream (320★).

🔐 Network & authentication

  • OpenID Connect Auth (⭐198) - Sign in through any OpenID Connect provider, including Authelia, Keycloak, and Authentik (198★).
  • TP-Link Router (⭐340) - Manages TP-Link and Mercusys routers with sensors, reboot button, switches, and per-client device tracking (340★).
  • Mikrotik Router (⭐444) - Pulls Mikrotik routers and access points into your dashboard, with per-client traffic, DHCP leases, and PoE controls (443★).

📊 Logging & analytics

  • Unraid (⭐233) - Monitors and controls an Unraid NAS, including CPU, memory, disks, virtual machines, and Docker containers (232★).

📋 Status & info rows

  • Timer Bar Card (⭐572) - Progress-bar card for any timer entity, with countdown, formatted remaining time, and configurable colors (568★).

☀️ Weather cards

  • Clock Weather Card (⭐821) - Combined date, time, and weather forecast card with an iOS-inspired layout for the days ahead (820★).
  • Horizon Card (⭐646) - Visualises the position of the Sun over the horizon throughout the day, with sunrise, sunset, and twilight markers (644★).

📅 Calendar & feed

  • Calendar Card Pro (⭐1.1k) - Customizable calendar card with event grouping, location indicators, and a clean modern look (1,100★).

Themes

  • Nordic (⭐41) - Light and dark themes in a Nordic palette, with several blue-tinted variants (41★).

entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on May 08, 2026
entry.content:
🌍 In your language

  • 🇧🇷 Home Assistant Brasil - Brazilian Portuguese Telegram group for users of all skill levels.
  • 🇳🇱 Home Assistant NL - Dutch-language Telegram group.
  • 🇫🇷 HACF Forum - Discussion forum of the French-speaking association HACF (Home Assistant Communauté Française).
  • 🇮🇹 Home Assistant Italia - Italian Telegram group for sharing ideas and projects.
  • 🇷🇺 Home Assistant RU Telegram - Russian-speaking Telegram group.

🧩 Around community projects

  • AppDaemon Discord - Help with the Python automation framework that runs alongside the core.
  • Frigate Discussions (⭐32k) - GitHub Discussions for the local-NVR / object-detection project.
  • HACS Discord - Help with the Home Assistant Community Store.
  • Music Assistant Discord - Chat for the multi-room music server.
  • NetDaemon Discord - Help with writing automations in C# / .NET.
  • Tasmota Discord - Chat for the ESP firmware that powers many Sonoff and eWeLink devices.
  • Z-Wave JS Discord - Chat for the Z-Wave JS stack used by the Z-Wave integration.
  • Zigbee2MQTT Discussions (⭐15k) - GitHub Discussions for the popular Zigbee bridge.

💬 Other community spaces

  • Home Assistant International Telegram - English-speaking Telegram group for the wider international community.

Public Configurations

  • Ryan Warner (⭐5) - Docker on Ubuntu HA Config, maintained since early HA. Highly documented and regularly updated (5★).

🤖 AI & LLMs

  • LLM Vision (⭐1.3k) - Add visual intelligence to your automations: caption camera snapshots, summarize what is happening, react to specific events (1,325★).
  • AI Automation Suggester (⭐721) - Scan your entities and ask an AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Ollama) for tailored automation suggestions, surfaced as notifications (721★).

💡 Lighting

  • Adaptive Lighting (⭐3.3k) - Slowly adjust the brightness and color temperature of your lights based on the position of the sun (3,279★).
  • Govee (⭐349) - Local control of Govee Wi-Fi lights and bulbs, including effects and color modes (349★).

🌡️ Climate

  • Better Thermostat (⭐1.4k) - Smarter thermostat with window detection, heating curves, and per-room comfort profiles for thermostatic radiator valves (1,389★).
  • Versatile Thermostat (⭐1k) - Full-featured thermostat with presets, window detection, motion-based comfort, and presence (1,040★).
  • Midea Air Appliances LAN (⭐451) - Local control of Midea air conditioners, dehumidifiers, and other appliances over LAN (451★).

⚡ Energy & solar

  • Powercalc (⭐1.5k) - Calculate estimated power consumption of lights and other devices, even those that don't report it themselves (1,472★).
  • Anker Solix (⭐963) - Pull Anker Solix balcony solar systems, batteries, and power stations into the energy dashboard with live state, history, and charging control (963★).
  • Octopus Energy (⭐918) - Pull Octopus Energy tariffs, smart meter readings, intelligent dispatch slots, and saving sessions into your dashboard (918★).
  • Huawei Solar (⭐882) - Read and control Huawei solar inverters and home batteries over Modbus, including grid charge windows (882★).
  • SolaX Modbus (⭐484) - Talk to SolaX, Solinteg, Sofar, Growatt, and other inverters over Modbus, including read-only and inverter control modes (484★).
  • Solarman (⭐462) - Read Deye, Sofar, and other Solarman-branded inverters via the Solarman stick logger (462★).
  • OCPP (⭐362) - Bring electric vehicle chargers that speak OCPP into the energy dashboard, with start, stop, and per-session metering (362★).

📹 Cameras & video

  • Frigate (⭐1.2k) - Integrate the Frigate NVR with local object detection into your dashboard, alerts, and snapshots (1,153★).
  • Eufy Security (⭐1.3k) - Manage Eufy Security cameras, doorbells, and base stations with live streams and event notifications (1,318★).
  • Tapo Control (⭐1.9k) - Control TP-Link Tapo cameras with PTZ, motion events, and a live RTSP stream (1,861★).
  • Dahua (⭐532) - Pair Dahua cameras and doorbells with motion events, snapshots, sirens, and PTZ controls (532★).

🚨 Security & alarm

  • Alarmo (⭐2.1k) - Easy-to-use alarm system with arm/disarm flows, user codes, zones, and panic mode (2,109★).

🔊 Voice & media playback

  • Alexa Media Player (⭐1.9k) - Control Amazon Alexa devices: announce, play media, and pull device state into your automations (1,935★).
  • YandexStation (⭐1.8k) - Control Yandex Station speakers and other smart-home devices through Alice (1,837★).
  • Yandex Smart Home (⭐1k) - Expose your devices to Yandex Alice and the Yandex smart-home app (1,046★).

🚗 Cars & EV charging

  • Kia Uvo & Hyundai Bluelink (⭐851) - Track and control Kia Connect (Uvo) and Hyundai Bluelink cars across EU, Canada, and USA, including charging, climate, and lock state (851★).
  • Tesla (⭐725) - Track Tesla cars and Powerwalls with charging, climate, location, and security state, using a refresh token from a third-party login app (725★).
  • Volkswagen Carnet (⭐512) - Track charging state, climate preconditioning, and remote lock and honk for Volkswagen cars on the Carnet platform (512★).

📍 Presence & location

  • iPhone Detect (⭐615) - Detect iPhones (and other phones) on the local Wi-Fi without an app, by sending a UDP probe and watching for the reply (615★).
  • Flightradar24 (⭐427) - Track aircraft flying over a configurable bounding box around your home using Flightradar24 (426★).

🧹 Vacuums

  • Dreame Vacuum (⭐1.9k) - Dreame robot vacuums with full map support, including no-go zones and selective room cleaning (1,916★).

🔵 Bluetooth & BLE

  • BLE Monitor (⭐2.2k) - Passively read sensor data from Xiaomi MiBeacon, Govee, ATC, Inkbird, Qingping, and many other BLE sensors (2,202★).
  • Bermuda (⭐1.8k) - Room-level presence detection by triangulating BLE signals across multiple ESPHome receivers (1,750★).

🔋 Battery monitoring

  • Battery Notes (⭐1.1k) - Annotate every device with its battery type and quantity, then track replacements, low-battery warnings, and history (1,078★).

🏷️ Vendor & brand

  • Xiaomi MIoT (⭐5.9k) - Auto-integrate Xiaomi smart-home devices over Wi-Fi, BLE, and Zigbee using the MIoT-spec protocol (5,859★).
  • Xiaomi Gateway 3 (⭐2.7k) - Local control of Xiaomi Multimode Gateway and Aqara Hub E1 over LAN, no cloud round-trips (2,745★).
  • Midea AC LAN (⭐1.6k) - Local control of Midea air conditioners, heat pumps, and other M-Smart devices (1,616★).
  • SmartThinQ Sensors (⭐1.3k) - LG appliances (washers, dryers, AC, fridges) wired up via SmartThinQ with rich state and remote start (1,296★).
  • Home Connect Alt (⭐952) - Alternative Home Connect integration for Bosch, Siemens, NEFF, and Gaggenau ovens, dishwashers, and washing machines, with richer state than the official one (952★).
  • Tapo Devices (⭐944) - TP-Link Tapo plugs, switches, bulbs, and energy monitoring (P100, P105, P110, L510, L530, L900) over LAN (944★).
  • Meross (⭐846) - Control Meross plugs, switches, bulbs, garage door openers, and humidifiers via the Meross IoT cloud (846★).
  • HomeMatic IP Local (⭐564) - Local control of HomeMatic and HomeMatic IP devices through OpenCCU or RaspberryMatic, no cloud round-trips (564★).
  • Nest Protect (⭐456) - Track Nest Protect smoke and CO alarms with battery state, recent events, and per-room safety status (456★).

🛠️ Automation tooling

  • Browser Mod (⭐1.7k) - Turn each browser into a controllable entity: pop up cards, navigate views, play sounds, or detect who is looking at the dashboard (1,730★).
  • Pyscript (⭐1.1k) - Write automations and templates in Python instead of YAML (1,150★).
  • Spook (⭐1.1k) - A toolbox of helpful sensors, services, and templates that surface things the UI normally hides (1,112★).
  • Scheduler Component (⭐874) - Build weekly schedules for any entity through a card-driven UI, no YAML required (874★).
  • Node-RED Companion (⭐568) - Companion component for the node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket project that exposes services, sensors, and binary sensors back to your dashboards (568★).
  • Magic Areas (⭐476) - Auto-build per-room presence, climate, and media area entities, with motion-triggered scenes and bright/dark detection (476★).
  • Auto Backup (⭐455) - Automate backups with custom schedules, retention rules, encryption, and uploads to remote storage (455★).
  • Multiscrape (⭐429) - Scrape multiple values (HTML, XML, or JSON) from a page in one request and turn them into sensors (429★).

🏘️ Civic & household

  • Mail and Packages (⭐826) - Sensors for incoming and delivered packages plus USPS Informed Delivery preview images, all from your existing email account (826★).
  • Irrigation Unlimited (⭐426) - Multi-zone irrigation controller with schedules, sequences, weather adjustments, and manual run support (426★).
  • Moonraker (Klipper) (⭐462) - Track Klipper-based 3D printers running Moonraker (Mainsail, Fluidd) with print progress, temperature, and webcam snapshots (462★).

🔐 Network & authentication

  • OIDC Auth (⭐899) - Sign in with single sign-on through any OpenID Connect provider, including Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, and Pocket ID (899★).

🔗 Federation & multi-instance

  • Remote Home Assistant (⭐1.2k) - Link multiple instances together so entities, services, and events flow between them (1,217★).

📊 Logging & analytics

  • TrueNAS (⭐364) - Pull TrueNAS Scale and Core stats, datasets, virtual machines, and apps into sensors and switches (364★).
  • Monitor Docker (⭐398) - Watch CPU, memory, network, and uptime for every Docker container on a host, including remote ones, and start or stop them from automations (398★).

🧱 Dashboard frameworks

  • Mushroom (⭐5k) - A complete card collection with a soft, mobile-first aesthetic that you can drop into existing dashboards (4,960★).
  • Bubble Card (⭐4.2k) - Minimalist card collection with a pop-up touch and rich customization (4,173★).
  • Floorplan (⭐1.5k) - Map entities onto an SVG of your house and animate them based on state changes (1,523★).
  • UI Lovelace Minimalist (⭐2k) - Drop-in dashboard collection with a uniform minimalist look across all your views, including ready-made cards and a button card library (2,019★).

📐 Layout helpers

  • Config Template Card (⭐547) - Allow using templates in Lovelace (547★).
  • Button card (⭐2.4k) - Highly customizable button for your entities (2,432★).
  • Expander Card (⭐412) - Expandable and collapsible card to group and hide other cards behind a header (412★).
  • Layout Card (⭐1.2k) - Get fine-grained control over how cards are placed on your dashboard, including masonry-style and grid layouts (1,241★).
  • Vertical Stack In Card (⭐970) - Group multiple cards into a single sleek card with one shared border (970★).
  • Fold Entity Row (⭐706) - A foldable row that hides extra entities behind a header until clicked (706★).
  • State Switch (⭐456) - Dynamically swap one card for another based on the state of an entity, the time of day, or the user viewing (456★).
  • Swipe Navigation (⭐533) - Switch between dashboard views with a swipe gesture on mobile (533★).
  • Custom Card Features (⭐419) - Adds buttons, dropdowns, sliders, spinboxes, selectors, and toggles you can attach to tile cards to call any service (419★).
  • Custom Sidebar (⭐271) - Personalise the sidebar per user or device, hide pages, reorder them, or restyle the look (271★).
  • Paper Buttons Row (⭐359) - Highly configurable button rows that can call actions, fire haptics, and restyle per state (359★).
  • Streamline Card (⭐249) - Define a card template once and reuse it across the dashboard with different entities, no copy-paste YAML (249★).

📈 Charts & graphs

  • Dual Gauge Card (⭐220) - Shows two gauges in one (220★).
  • ApexCharts Card (⭐1.8k) - Advanced graphs and charts powered by ApexChartsJS with timelines, multi-axis, and event markers (1,769★).
  • Sankey Chart (⭐650) - Sankey-style flow diagram for visualising power, water, or any other flow across your home (650★).
  • Modern Circular Gauge (⭐264) - Modern-looking circular gauge card with smooth animations, color stops, and template support (264★).
  • Flex Table Card (⭐265) - Highly flexible table card with arbitrary columns, regex-matched entities, and per-row styling, useful for AppDaemon and templated content (265★).

📋 Status & info rows

  • Battery State Card (⭐1.2k) - List devices with their battery levels in a tidy card, sorted and color-coded (1,235★).
  • Scheduler Card (⭐1.2k) - Build and edit weekly schedules for any entity right from the dashboard (1,220★).
  • Entity Progress Card (⭐250) - Progress-bar card for any numeric entity, with thresholds, gradients, and templated icons (250★).
  • Vehicle Status Card (⭐251) - Dashboard card showing fuel or charge level, range, doors, lock state, and a customizable image of the car (251★).

☀️ Weather cards

  • Weather Chart Card (⭐435) - Weather card with a chart-style hourly forecast and customizable layout (435★).
  • Hourly Weather (⭐387) - Show today's hourly forecast as a colored horizontal bar so you can see at a glance when conditions change (387★).
  • Weather Radar (⭐360) - Animated rain radar card using the public RainViewer tile service, with country-level and regional zoom (360★).

🌡️ Climate cards

  • Mini Climate (⭐318) - Compact climate card with current temperature, target, and per-mode controls, sized for small dashboards and mobile (318★).

⚡ Energy cards

  • Sunsynk Power Flow (⭐369) - Visualise the live energy flow of Sunsynk and Deye inverters, mirroring the layout of the inverter screen (369★).

💡 Lighting cards

  • Hue-Like Light Card (⭐360) - Light card styled and laid out like the Philips Hue app, with grouped scenes and per-bulb control (360★).
  • Light Entity Card (⭐281) - Compact card to control any light or switch entity with brightness, color temperature, and color picker (281★).

🗺️ Maps & location

  • ha-map-card (⭐110) - Leaflet-based map card with history trails, custom tile layers, and tap actions (110★).

📸 Camera cards

  • Advanced Camera Card (⭐1k) - Comprehensive camera card with timelines, galleries, snapshots, clips, and per-event playback (1,041★).

🧹 Vacuum cards

  • Vacuum Map Card (⭐1.9k) - This card provides a user-friendly way to fully control Xiaomi (Roborock/Viomi/Dreame/Roidmi) and Neato (+ possibly other) vacuums (1,863★).
  • Valetudo Map (⭐301) - Display the live map from a robot vacuum running Valetudo (cloudless firmware) directly on a dashboard (301★).

📅 Calendar & feed

  • Week Planner Card (⭐503) - Responsive multi-day overview of upcoming events, alarms, and reminders (503★).
  • Trash Card (⭐351) - Show the next trash pickup type (paper, plastic, organic) based on a calendar entity, with color-coded icons (351★).

📡 Remote control

  • HA Firemote (⭐956) - Virtual remote for Apple TV, Fire TV, Chromecast, Homatics, Shield, onn., Roku, Xiaomi, and more (956★).
  • Universal Remote Card (⭐549) - Fully customizable virtual remote for any media device, supporting custom buttons and haptics (549★).

🖥️ Kiosk & wallpanel

  • Wall Panel (⭐830) - Wall-panel mode and photo-screensaver for tablets mounted on the wall (829★).
  • Kiosk Mode (⭐714) - Hide the header, sidebar, and overflow menu for a clean kiosk-style view (714★).

Dashboards
